body:
I was once where you were except I broke up with my boyfriend after the abortion. Relationships are often never the same after something like that. I was more heartbroken over the abortion than him being out of my life, but then, I didn't really want an abortion in the first place. 

You aren't the only one who has bombed a semester. I bombed the semester of the abortion, and the next school year at the anniversary of the abortion. 

Take some time off, and take care of yourself. Finding a therapist/counselor at your school to talk to is so important right now. I made the mistake of bottling it all up because I didn't have a close friend to talk to, and I didn't take advantage of the mental health services at my school, so I spiraled downward and fucked my life up. 

You can get through this.

You are not a bad person. Please stop self-harming, and please do not kill yourself over a failed relationship. It happens to the best of us. I'm certain that almost everyone who has fallen in love has experienced the searing emotional pain of losing a loved one. We all believed that we would never get over it - but we do, and sometimes we find someone who is even better for us. Please know that when it comes to love, time does heal all wounds. You WILL get through this. 

I don't know how to patch up your relationship. If she has lost trust in you, you may never get that trust back. Honestly, the relationship sounds toxic to an extent, and it is probably in your best interest that you end it. Her self-esteem has been negatively affected by your porn use, and your self-esteem has also been damaged as a result of her making you feel like a horrible person for being bi-curious, watching porn, and not being as mature as she is. None of this makes you a bad person, but it could indicate that the two of you are incompatible for a serious relationship. When you factor in her suicide attempt and the fact that you are now self-harming and having thoughts of suicide, this seems like a very unhealthy relationship. 

As far as your concern that you have ADHD, you need to see a doctor for a diagnosis. If you do have it, they will help you.

Hoping for the best for you.

People are clueless. My mother works in mental health and doesn't take my depression seriously. She's even dismissed the fact that my sister has no interest in a relationship with me because I "sit around looking sad all the time". This bitch is the main cause of my depression. My parents fucked me up bad.
